description: EXCHANGE: cancel a task or claim, signed (nonce from coinop_tasks_nonce issued with op='cancel' and this taskId). Poster, while the task is open or claimed: full bounty refund (a claimed task's worker stake is returned). Worker, on your own unsubmitted claim: the task reopens and your stake is slashed.

nonce.description: One-time nonce from the matching coinop_*_nonce tool

signature.description: Caller's local signature over the nonce message — the key never leaves the caller's machine

name: coinop_task_cancel
